subject: CityConnect regional series — post-event impact review and lead attribution
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@cityconnect.events>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@cityconnect.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CityConnect series — raw lead export and preliminary KPI summary

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for sponsoring the CityConnect regional series last month — overall our on-site activation looked great and we appreciate Redwood’s presence. Attached is the raw lead export and a quick summary of registrations vs on-site conversions. A few numbers to highlight:

- 432 total booth interactions (badge scans)
- 218 qualified meetings booked on-site (mutual opt-in)
- 54 deals marked as MQL in our CRM so far
- Estimated influenced pipeline: $1.1M (internal estimate)

We flagged all leads with UTM campaign=cityconnect-2026 and source=partner. CityConnect also attributed some demo requests to the joint webinar we ran two weeks prior — we included that column in the CSV.

Would love a quick confirmation that Redwood’s team will use the attached CSV as the source of truth for attribution and then confirm any leads you disagree with. Finance also requested a post-event cost sheet so I included the event-level costs file (cityconnect-postevent-costs.xlsx).

Thanks,
Sam Ortiz
Partnerships — CityConnect Events
attachments: CityConnect-Q3-leads.csv (text/csv), cityconnect-postevent-costs.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@cityconnect.events>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CityConnect series — raw lead export and preliminary KPI summary

Thanks Sam — appreciate the files. I pulled the CSV and started a quick reconciliation vs our CRM. Two quick items from Redwood’s side:

1) Attribution logic: our inbound team will treat UTM campaign=cityconnect-2026 as primary source, but we also apply 'last-touch' for demo requests coming from the webinar link (utm_medium=webinar). If a record has both, we flag it for manual review.

2) Lead quality: we only mark leads as MQL if they meet 3 of 4 qualification signals (company size, title, intent score, demo request). Roughly 30% of the flagged MQLs in your export missing title or company fields. Can you confirm whether CityConnect collected job title for all scans or if that field is optional on your scan form?

Ben/Marissa/Tessa — looping you in because we need:
- Ben: can you triage which of these 54 MQLs are already in our pipeline (deal stage) and confirm any closed/won conversions? HubSpot link in related_links.
- Marissa: we’ll need a short retro (one page) capturing conversion rates and top friction causes for the next regional. Can you own that?
- Tessa: can you confirm the booth form used (link to form template) and whether title/company were required fields?

I propose we lock attribution decisions by Friday (2026-10-23) so finance and ops can finalize the sponsorship reconciliation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@cityconnect.events>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CityConnect series — raw lead export and preliminary KPI summary

Neha / team — I ran the CSV against our CRM. Quick summary:

- 54 external MQLs in CityConnect export -> 42 matched to existing contacts in HubSpot (email or phone); 12 appear as net-new leads.
- From the 42 matched: 6 are already in active opportunities (2 in proposal, 1 closed-won last week, 3 in discovery). The closed-won is a $72k ARR logo (salesforce sync complete).
- The 12 net-new leads: 8 meet our internal MQL criteria after enrichment; 4 are marketing-qualified only (missing title/company or low intent score).

I attached a short reconciliation table to HubSpot (see note on the contact record). For the 7 cases where CityConnect marked source=webinar and the contact also had a direct demo request, I set a manual tag 'cityconnect-webinar-conflict' and left them for Neha to review.

Sam — quick question on data hygiene: several exported records have phone numbers in inconsistent formats, and six entries appear to be duplicates with different emails. Were you de-duping on-site scans or exporting raw device scans? If raw, we can help with a one-time cleanse for future events.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: reconciliation-note (linked in HubSpot)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@cityconnect.events>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CityConnect series — raw lead export and preliminary KPI summary

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. I pulled the reconciled list Ben linked and drafted the one-page retro (key ask: move required fields to mandatory on the badge scan; add a checkbox for 'interested in demo' to reduce manual tagging). Key takeaways:

- Net influenced pipeline (post-clean): $970,000 (down from CityConnect's estimate once we applied our MQL rules and removed duplicates).
- Conversion leakage: ~18% of badge scans that expressed interest did not submit contact details (form abandonment).
- Action items:
  - Tessa to update form template and make title/company required for next series (due 2026-11-05).
  - Neha to finalize attribution tags in HubSpot and confirm which 7 webinar-conflict leads get webinar vs event credit (due 2026-10-23).
  - Sam/CityConnect to provide cleaned phone/email formats going forward.

Sam — could you confirm whether CityConnect is comfortable with Redwood’s post-clean pipeline figure ($970k) for reporting purposes? If cityconnect will include the gross $1.1M number in their public materials, we should add a note explaining differences in qualification methodology.

Thanks — I’ll attach the one-pager to the HubSpot record and mark the thread resolved once attribution is locked.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
attachments: cityconnect-retro-onepage.pdf (draft)
